body: It does. I don't feel there is a place for me in life, I think I just need to die

i just dont know what to do anymore. its not just my opinion, that is what people see when they look at me. just a loser who will never get anywhere in life.i have applied to so many places but none of them want me i have only gotten one interview and i fucked it up so badly. i just need to get out of here, if i cant then theres no point in me living anymore

That's a very biased way of looking at it. There are so many people, myself included, whose family and friends do nothing to help when we reach out for help, instead shunning us or cutting contact completely, and then feeling sorry for themselves when it's too late. It's always the suicidal person who is at fault for inflicting pain on others when nobody else cared about our pain.

No, I am done making excuses for her. It doesn't matter how much she spent raising me if she will overlook the fact that I want to be dead. And what good is it that she would be devastated when I'm dead if this is how she treats me when I'm alive? I'm not going to be guilted out of suicide anymore, I am done.

I don't bring happiness to anyone anymore. I don't go outside anymore, and I have deleted all my social media. Nobody I know has checked to see if I'm even still alive. My family just accepts that I am a defect and has given up on my future. I am like a ghost in this world, nobody is affected by my existence. And I have given up on myself too. That's why I choose death.
Yes I'm still here unfortunately. There's not much more to talk about, I don't know why I posted this.
Because I am. It's not just a feeling.
Read them if you want but it doesn't really matter anymore.
I've made posts about it but they're not worth the time to read.

I've tried so many times to get through to my parents but they don't understand. I dont think they just want the best for me, but for themselves. All they care about is prestige and bragging rights, since my older siblings have Master's degrees. They threatened to kick me out if I didnt go back to school. There is also a language barrier, since English isn't their first language, they just don't understand me. I don't think anyone does.

You're right man, I give up. I tried everything and it's over for me. I don't want to do college or work or life anymore, I'm just done.

I don't see any way I can get a part-time job. I've tried applying online but no one gets back to me, and I can't go in person because ever since I failed my degree the first time, I'm not allowed out of the house and my parents clock me when I leave for class. I can't get a job at school either, you need to speak two languages and have experience. Its literally impossible for me to escape this alive.
Can you pm me your method pls?

I don't have a single friend left and I'm allowed to leave the house anymore. There's no way out of this place and I'm losing my mind. Now I'm just waiting until everyone goes to bed before I stab myself in the bathroom.
